Railway RRC SR Apprentice Online Form 2026 (4471 Posts) – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Cell Southern Railway (RRC-SR) has released the notification for the post of various Trade Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 4471 posts. Online applying process for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 28 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 27 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
